method: Model-assisted lexical review, not native-human certification. Every one of the initial 1,830 candidate headwords was inspected with compact supplied sense summaries; ambiguous homographs, source anomalies, grammatical entries, and alternative primary senses were then inspected in their full supplied records. The approved array records the resulting individual inclusion decisions. Exact primary-sense text is copied from the candidate evidence. Historical mixed-country spelling Zipf was only a candidate-generation signal, not evidence of current Sweden usage or sense frequency. A subsequent expansion added 28 eleven-letter candidates; each was reviewed from its full supplied record, preserving all prior decisions. The reviewed candidate total is now 1,858. A subsequent teaching-text audit reread all approved primary glosses, inspected full records for suspect cross-references, semantic overclaims and part-of-speech mismatches, excluded defective records without an eligible teaching alternative, and replaced several primary senses only with exact supplied alternatives. No new English translations were invented. Exact defective gloss strings are also recorded in omittedGlosses for runtime suppression, including for valid-guess-only entries; source evidence remains unchanged.
policy: Select ordinary contemporary standalone Swedish vocabulary suitable for Sweden. Preserve Å, Ä and Ö as distinct letters. Accept familiar function words, established loans, common informal vocabulary, independently defined adverbs, lexicalized adjectives and plural-only nouns. Reject morphology-only records, name/abbreviation-only entries, source errors, archaic/regional or overly specialized homographs, phrase-only records, profanity and strongly distressing surprise answers. A common spelling or an innocent secondary gloss does not automatically qualify a word. Guesses are unchanged. Candidate spelling-Zipf thresholds are >=4.3 for lengths 3–10 and >=4.0 for length 11; these are historical mixed-country spelling frequencies, not sense-frequency guarantees. The longer pool is expanded only with individually accepted natural vocabulary, never artificial seam constructions.
